        "contents": "export class HistoricalTourToolsImplementation implements TourToolsImplementation {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  /**\n   * Navigate through historical tour with intelligent waypoint selection\n   */\n  async navigate_historical_tour(params: NavigateHistoricalTourParams): Promise\u003cTourResult\u003e {\n    try {\n      const startTime = performance.now()\n      \n      // Determine target waypoint based on parameters\n      let targetWaypointIndex: number\n      \n      if (params.direction === \"jump_to_period\" \u0026\u0026 params.target_period) {\n        targetWaypointIndex = await this.findWaypointForPeriod(params.target_period)\n      } else if (params.direction === \"jump_to_period\" \u0026\u0026 params.target_year) {\n        targetWaypointIndex = await this.findWaypointForYear(params.target_year)\n      } else if (params.direction === \"forward\") {\n        targetWaypointIndex = Math.min(\n          this.tourController.currentWaypointIndex + 1,\n          this.tourController.waypoints.length - 1\n        )\n      } else { // backward\n        targetWaypointIndex = Math.max(this.tourController.currentWaypointIndex - 1, 0)\n      }\n      \n      // Apply narrative focus if specified\n      if (params.narrative_focus) {\n        await this.applyNarrativeFocus(params.narrative_focus)\n      }\n      \n      // Navigate to waypoint with layout optimization\n      await this.tourController.navigateToWaypoint(targetWaypointIndex)\n      \n      // Apply depth level configuration\n      if (params.depth_level) {\n        await this.configureDepthLevel(params.depth_level)\n      }\n      \n      // Get current state after navigation\n      const currentState = this.getCurrentState()\n      const currentWaypoint = this.tourController.waypoints[targetWaypointIndex]\n      \n      const endTime = performance.now()\n      this.updatePerformanceMetrics('navigate_historical_tour', endTime - startTime, true)",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  /**\n   * Navigate through historical tour with intelligent waypoint selection\n   */\n  async navigate_historical_tour(params: NavigateHistoricalTourParams): Promise\u003cTourResult\u003e {\n    try {\n      const startTime = performance.now()\n      \n      // Determine target waypoint based on parameters\n      let targetWaypointIndex: number\n      \n      if (params.direction === \"jump_to_period\" \u0026\u0026 params.target_period) {\n        targetWaypointIndex = await this.findWaypointForPeriod(params.target_period)\n      } else if (params.direction === \"jump_to_period\" \u0026\u0026 params.target_year) {\n        targetWaypointIndex = await this.findWaypointForYear(params.target_year)\n      } else if (params.direction === \"forward\") {\n        targetWaypointIndex = Math.min(\n          this.tourController.currentWaypointIndex + 1,\n          this.tourController.waypoints.length - 1\n        )\n      } else { // backward\n        targetWaypointIndex = Math.max(this.tourController.currentWaypointIndex - 1, 0)\n      }\n      \n      // Apply narrative focus if specified\n      if (params.narrative_focus) {\n        await this.applyNarrativeFocus(params.narrative_focus)\n      }\n      \n      // Navigate to waypoint with layout optimization\n      await this.tourController.navigateToWaypoint(targetWaypointIndex)\n      \n      // Apply depth level configuration\n      if (params.depth_level) {\n        await this.configureDepthLevel(params.depth_level)\n      }\n      \n      // Get current state after navigation\n      const currentState = this.getCurrentState()\n      const currentWaypoint = this.tourController.waypoints[targetWaypointIndex]\n      \n      const endTime = performance.now()\n      this.updatePerformanceMetrics('navigate_historical_tour', endTime - startTime, true)",

        "contents": "export function useTour() {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const navigateToWaypoint = useCallback( async ( waypointIndex: number ) =\u003e {\n    if ( !currentTour.current || !state.isActive ) {\n      console.warn( 'Cannot navigate: no active tour' )\n      return false\n    }\n\n    const tour = currentTour.current\n    const waypoint = tour.waypoints[waypointIndex]\n\n    if ( !waypoint ) {\n      console.warn( &#96;Waypoint at index ${waypointIndex} not found&#96; )\n      return false\n    }\n\n    // Record completion of previous waypoint if applicable\n    if ( state.currentWaypointId \u0026\u0026 waypointStartTime.current \u003e 0 ) {\n      const duration = Math.floor( ( Date.now() - waypointStartTime.current ) / 1000 )\n\n      dispatch( {\n        type: 'COMPLETE_WAYPOINT',\n        payload: {\n          waypointId: state.currentWaypointId,\n          duration\n        }\n      } )\n\n      dispatch( {\n        type: 'ADD_HISTORY_ENTRY',\n        payload: {\n          waypointId: state.currentWaypointId,\n          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n          action: 'completed',\n          duration\n        }\n      } )\n    }\n\n    // Navigate to new waypoint\n    dispatch( {\n      type: 'NAVIGATE_TO_WAYPOINT',\n      payload: { waypointIndex }\n    } )\n\n    // Update current waypoint ID\n    dispatch( {\n      type: 'SET_STATE',\n      payload: { currentWaypointId: waypoint.id }\n    } )\n\n    // Update URL\n    updateURL( tour.id, waypointIndex )\n\n    // Record waypoint entry\n    waypointStartTime.current = Date.now()\n\n    dispatch( {\n      type: 'ADD_HISTORY_ENTRY',\n      payload: {\n        waypointId: waypoint.id,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        action: 'started',\n        duration: 0\n      }\n    } )\n\n    dispatchEvent( {\n      type: 'waypointEntered',\n      tourId: tour.id,\n      waypointId: waypoint.id,\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      data: { waypointIndex, waypoint }\n    } )\n\n    return true\n  }, [state.isActive, state.currentWaypointId, updateURL, dispatchEvent] )",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  const navigateToWaypoint = useCallback( async ( waypointIndex: number ) =\u003e {\n    if ( !currentTour.current || !state.isActive ) {\n      console.warn( 'Cannot navigate: no active tour' )\n      return false\n    }\n\n    const tour = currentTour.current\n    const waypoint = tour.waypoints[waypointIndex]\n\n    if ( !waypoint ) {\n      console.warn( &#96;Waypoint at index ${waypointIndex} not found&#96; )\n      return false\n    }\n\n    // Record completion of previous waypoint if applicable\n    if ( state.currentWaypointId \u0026\u0026 waypointStartTime.current \u003e 0 ) {\n      const duration = Math.floor( ( Date.now() - waypointStartTime.current ) / 1000 )\n\n      dispatch( {\n        type: 'COMPLETE_WAYPOINT',\n        payload: {\n          waypointId: state.currentWaypointId,\n          duration\n        }\n      } )\n\n      dispatch( {\n        type: 'ADD_HISTORY_ENTRY',\n        payload: {\n          waypointId: state.currentWaypointId,\n          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n          action: 'completed',\n          duration\n        }\n      } )\n    }\n\n    // Navigate to new waypoint\n    dispatch( {\n      type: 'NAVIGATE_TO_WAYPOINT',\n      payload: { waypointIndex }\n    } )\n\n    // Update current waypoint ID\n    dispatch( {\n      type: 'SET_STATE',\n      payload: { currentWaypointId: waypoint.id }\n    } )\n\n    // Update URL\n    updateURL( tour.id, waypointIndex )\n\n    // Record waypoint entry\n    waypointStartTime.current = Date.now()\n\n    dispatch( {\n      type: 'ADD_HISTORY_ENTRY',\n      payload: {\n        waypointId: waypoint.id,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        action: 'started',\n        duration: 0\n      }\n    } )\n\n    dispatchEvent( {\n      type: 'waypointEntered',\n      tourId: tour.id,\n      waypointId: waypoint.id,\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      data: { waypointIndex, waypoint }\n    } )\n\n    return true\n  }, [state.isActive, state.currentWaypointId, updateURL, dispatchEvent] )",

        "contents": "export function useFamousEventsTour() {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Navigate to next waypoint\n  const navigateToNextWaypoint = useCallback(async () =\u003e {\n    if (!tour || !tourAgent || currentWaypointIndex \u003e= tour.waypoints.length - 1) {\n      return\n    }\n\n    setIsLoading(true)\n    try {\n      const currentWaypoint = tour.waypoints[currentWaypointIndex]\n      const result = await tourAgent.progressToNextWaypoint(currentWaypoint.id)\n      \n      if (result.nextWaypoint) {\n        setCurrentWaypointIndex(prev =\u003e prev + 1)\n        await loadWaypointIntoMindmap(result.nextWaypoint)\n        \n        // Add related records as additional nodes if any\n        if (result.relatedRecords.length \u003e 0) {\n          const relatedNodes = result.relatedRecords.slice(0, 3).map((record, index) =\u003e ({\n            id: record.id || &#96;related-${Date.now()}-${index}&#96;,\n            type: 'entityNode',\n            position: {\n              x: result.nextWaypoint.position.x + (index + 1) * 150,\n              y: result.nextWaypoint.position.y + 100\n            },\n            data: record\n          }))\n          \n          setNodes(nodes =\u003e [...nodes, ...relatedNodes])\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Failed to navigate to next waypoint:', error)\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false)\n    }\n  }, [tour, tourAgent, currentWaypointIndex, loadWaypointIntoMindmap, setNodes])\n\n  // Navigate to previous waypoint\n  const navigateToPreviousWaypoint = useCallback(async () =\u003e {\n    if (!tour || currentWaypointIndex \u003c= 0) {\n      return\n    }\n\n    const prevIndex = currentWaypointIndex - 1\n    setCurrentWaypointIndex(prevIndex)\n    await loadWaypointIntoMindmap(tour.waypoints[prevIndex])\n  }, [tour, currentWaypointIndex, loadWaypointIntoMindmap])",

        "contents": "\n\nexport function useTour() {\n  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer( tourReducer, initialTourState )\n  const router = useRouter()\n  const pathname = usePathname()\n  const searchParams = useSearchParams()\n\n  // Event handlers and tour definition storage\n  const eventHandlers = useRef\u003cMap\u003cTourEventType, TourEventHandler[]\u003e\u003e( new Map() )\n  const currentTour = useRef\u003cTourDefinition | null\u003e( null )\n  const waypointStartTime = useRef\u003cnumber\u003e( 0 )\n\n  // URL-driven navigation support\n  const updateURL = useCallback( ( tourId: string, waypointIndex: number ) =\u003e {\n    const params = new URLSearchParams( searchParams )\n    params.set( 'step', waypointIndex.toString() )\n\n    const newURL = &#96;/mindmap/tour/${tourId}?${params.toString()}&#96;\n    router.push( newURL, { scroll: false } )\n  }, [router, searchParams] )\n\n  // Parse URL parameters for tour state\n  const parseURLParams = useCallback( () =\u003e {\n    const pathSegments = pathname.split( '/' )\n    const tourId = pathSegments[pathSegments.indexOf( 'tour' ) + 1]\n    const step = searchParams.get( 'step' )\n\n    return {\n      tourId: tourId || null,\n      waypointIndex: step ? parseInt( step, 10 ) : 0\n    }\n  }, [pathname, searchParams] )\n\n  // Event system\n  const addEventListener = useCallback( ( eventType: TourEventType, handler: TourEventHandler ) =\u003e {\n    const handlers = eventHandlers.current.get( eventType ) || []\n    handlers.push( handler )\n    eventHandlers.current.set( eventType, handlers )\n\n    // Return cleanup function\n    return () =\u003e {\n      const currentHandlers = eventHandlers.current.get( eventType ) || []\n      const filteredHandlers = currentHandlers.filter( h =\u003e h !== handler )\n      eventHandlers.current.set( eventType, filteredHandlers )\n    }\n  }, [] )",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport function useTour() {\n  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer( tourReducer, initialTourState )\n  const router = useRouter()\n  const pathname = usePathname()\n  const searchParams = useSearchParams()\n\n  // Event handlers and tour definition storage\n  const eventHandlers = useRef\u003cMap\u003cTourEventType, TourEventHandler[]\u003e\u003e( new Map() )\n  const currentTour = useRef\u003cTourDefinition | null\u003e( null )\n  const waypointStartTime = useRef\u003cnumber\u003e( 0 )\n\n  // URL-driven navigation support\n  const updateURL = useCallback( ( tourId: string, waypointIndex: number ) =\u003e {\n    const params = new URLSearchParams( searchParams )\n    params.set( 'step', waypointIndex.toString() )\n\n    const newURL = &#96;/mindmap/tour/${tourId}?${params.toString()}&#96;\n    router.push( newURL, { scroll: false } )\n  }, [router, searchParams] )\n\n  // Parse URL parameters for tour state\n  const parseURLParams = useCallback( () =\u003e {\n    const pathSegments = pathname.split( '/' )\n    const tourId = pathSegments[pathSegments.indexOf( 'tour' ) + 1]\n    const step = searchParams.get( 'step' )\n\n    return {\n      tourId: tourId || null,\n      waypointIndex: step ? parseInt( step, 10 ) : 0\n    }\n  }, [pathname, searchParams] )\n\n  // Event system\n  const addEventListener = useCallback( ( eventType: TourEventType, handler: TourEventHandler ) =\u003e {\n    const handlers = eventHandlers.current.get( eventType ) || []\n    handlers.push( handler )\n    eventHandlers.current.set( eventType, handlers )\n\n    // Return cleanup function\n    return () =\u003e {\n      const currentHandlers = eventHandlers.current.get( eventType ) || []\n      const filteredHandlers = currentHandlers.filter( h =\u003e h !== handler )\n      eventHandlers.current.set( eventType, filteredHandlers )\n    }\n  }, [] )",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export function PrometheusPage({\n  PrometheusAgent,\n  breadcrumbBasePath = '/explore',\n}: PrometheusPageProps) {\n  ...\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n\n\n    ...\n\n\n    // Fragment Shader with proximity-based lighting adjustment and theme awareness\n    const fragmentShader = &#96;\n    uniform float iTime;\n    uniform vec2 iResolution;\n    uniform vec2 mouse;\n    uniform float grainStrength; // Uniform for controlling grain strength\n    uniform float grainIntensity; // Uniform for controlling grain intensity\n    uniform float themeMode; // 1.0 for dark, 0.0 for light\n    varying vec2 vUv;\n\n    // 2D Random\n    float random(in vec2 st) {\n        return fract(sin(dot(st.xy, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453123);\n    }\n\n    // 2D Noise based on Morgan McGuire @morgan3d\n    float noise(in vec2 st) {\n        vec2 i = floor(st);\n        vec2 f = fract(st);\n\n        // Four corners in 2D of a tile\n        float a = random(i);\n        float b = random(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0));\n        float c = random(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0));\n        float d = random(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0));\n\n        vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);\n\n        return mix(a, b, u.x) +\n               (c - a) * u.y * (1.0 - u.x) +\n               (d - b) * u.x * u.y;\n    }\n\n    // Function to add static grain/noise effect\n    float grain(vec2 uv) {\n        return random(uv * grainIntensity) * grainStrength; // Static grain based on UV coordinates\n    }\n\n    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {\n        // Get the normalized coordinates (0 to 1)\n        vec2 uv = fragCoord.xy / iResolution.xy;\n        \n        // Correct the aspect ratio\n        uv = uv * 2.0 - 1.0;\n        uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;\n\n        vec2 mousePos = mouse / iResolution.xy * 2.0 - 1.0; // Normalize mouse to -1 to 1\n        vec3 color = vec3(0.0);\n\n        float count = 36.0;\n\n        for (float i = 0.0; i \u003c count; i++) {\n            // Calculate the distance and angle from the center of the circle\n            float dist = length(uv);\n            float angle = atan(uv.y, uv.x);\n\n            // Introduce some variation in the radius based on the mouse position and noise\n            float radius = 0.2 + (count - i) * 0.012 + noise(uv + iTime - i * 0.04) * 0.1;\n            radius += length(uv - mousePos) * 0.1; // React to the cursor's proximity\n\n            // Adjust the thickness dynamically\n            float thickness = 0.008 + sin(iTime + dist * 10.0) * 0.005;\n\n            float sep = 0.03;\n            float noisyRadius = radius + noise(uv + iTime - i * sep) * 0.05;\n\n            // Calculate the edge using smoothstep\n            float edge = smoothstep(noisyRadius - thickness, noisyRadius, dist) - smoothstep(noisyRadius, noisyRadius + thickness, dist);\n\n            // Proximity-based light adjustment (only affects circles)\n            float proximity = 1.0 - length(uv - mousePos); // Closer = more light, further = less light\n            float brightness = mix(0.3, 1.5, proximity);  // Mix between dim (0.3) and bright (1.5) based on proximity\n\n            color += vec3(edge * brightness) * pow((count - i) / count, 2.0) * 0.5;\n        }\n\n        // Convert color to grayscale for black and white effect\n        float grayscale = dot(color, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));\n\n        // Apply static grain effect\n        grayscale += grain(vUv);\n\n        // Theme-aware output: invert for light mode\n        float finalColor = mix(1.0 - grayscale, grayscale, themeMode);\n        \n        // Set the output color as theme-aware black and white with static grain\n        fragColor = vec4(vec3(finalColor), 1.0);\n    }\n\n    void main() {\n        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);\n    }\n",

          {

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 82,

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

            "text": "        return mix(a, b, u.x) +"

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

        "originalContents": "\n\n    // Fragment Shader with proximity-based lighting adjustment and theme awareness\n    const fragmentShader = &#96;\n    uniform float iTime;\n    uniform vec2 iResolution;\n    uniform vec2 mouse;\n    uniform float grainStrength; // Uniform for controlling grain strength\n    uniform float grainIntensity; // Uniform for controlling grain intensity\n    uniform float themeMode; // 1.0 for dark, 0.0 for light\n    varying vec2 vUv;\n\n    // 2D Random\n    float random(in vec2 st) {\n        return fract(sin(dot(st.xy, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453123);\n    }\n\n    // 2D Noise based on Morgan McGuire @morgan3d\n    float noise(in vec2 st) {\n        vec2 i = floor(st);\n        vec2 f = fract(st);\n\n        // Four corners in 2D of a tile\n        float a = random(i);\n        float b = random(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0));\n        float c = random(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0));\n        float d = random(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0));\n\n        vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);\n\n        return mix(a, b, u.x) +\n               (c - a) * u.y * (1.0 - u.x) +\n               (d - b) * u.x * u.y;\n    }\n\n    // Function to add static grain/noise effect\n    float grain(vec2 uv) {\n        return random(uv * grainIntensity) * grainStrength; // Static grain based on UV coordinates\n    }\n\n    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {\n        // Get the normalized coordinates (0 to 1)\n        vec2 uv = fragCoord.xy / iResolution.xy;\n        \n        // Correct the aspect ratio\n        uv = uv * 2.0 - 1.0;\n        uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;\n\n        vec2 mousePos = mouse / iResolution.xy * 2.0 - 1.0; // Normalize mouse to -1 to 1\n        vec3 color = vec3(0.0);\n\n        float count = 36.0;\n\n        for (float i = 0.0; i \u003c count; i++) {\n            // Calculate the distance and angle from the center of the circle\n            float dist = length(uv);\n            float angle = atan(uv.y, uv.x);\n\n            // Introduce some variation in the radius based on the mouse position and noise\n            float radius = 0.2 + (count - i) * 0.012 + noise(uv + iTime - i * 0.04) * 0.1;\n            radius += length(uv - mousePos) * 0.1; // React to the cursor's proximity\n\n            // Adjust the thickness dynamically\n            float thickness = 0.008 + sin(iTime + dist * 10.0) * 0.005;\n\n            float sep = 0.03;\n            float noisyRadius = radius + noise(uv + iTime - i * sep) * 0.05;\n\n            // Calculate the edge using smoothstep\n            float edge = smoothstep(noisyRadius - thickness, noisyRadius, dist) - smoothstep(noisyRadius, noisyRadius + thickness, dist);\n\n            // Proximity-based light adjustment (only affects circles)\n            float proximity = 1.0 - length(uv - mousePos); // Closer = more light, further = less light\n            float brightness = mix(0.3, 1.5, proximity);  // Mix between dim (0.3) and bright (1.5) based on proximity\n\n            color += vec3(edge * brightness) * pow((count - i) / count, 2.0) * 0.5;\n        }\n\n        // Convert color to grayscale for black and white effect\n        float grayscale = dot(color, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));\n\n        // Apply static grain effect\n        grayscale += grain(vUv);\n\n        // Theme-aware output: invert for light mode\n        float finalColor = mix(1.0 - grayscale, grayscale, themeMode);\n        \n        // Set the output color as theme-aware black and white with static grain\n        fragColor = vec4(vec3(finalColor), 1.0);\n    }\n\n    void main() {\n        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);\n    }\n",

        "contents": "export function PrometheusPage({\n  PrometheusAgent,\n  breadcrumbBasePath = '/explore',\n}: PrometheusPageProps) {\n  ...\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    ...\n    const fragmentShader = &#96;\n...\n&#96;\n\n    // Material that applies the shader effect with theme awareness\n    const isDark = theme === 'dark'\n    const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({\n      uniforms: {\n        iTime: {value: 0},\n        iResolution: {\n          value: new THREE.Vector2(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight),\n        },\n        mouse: {value: new THREE.Vector2(0, 0)},\n        grainStrength: {value: isDark ? 0.05 : 0.02}, // Adjust grain for theme\n        grainIntensity: {value: isDark ? 50.0 : 30.0}, // Adjust intensity for theme\n        themeMode: {value: isDark ? 1.0 : 0.0}, // Theme uniform for shader\n      },\n      vertexShader: vertexShader,\n      fragmentShader: fragmentShader,\n    })\n\n    // Create a plane covering the entire canvas and apply the shader material\n    const plane = new THREE.Mesh(planeGeometry, material)\n    scene.add(plane)\n\n    // Store material reference for theme updates\n    setShaderMaterial(material)\n\n    // Camera position\n    camera.position.z = 1\n\n    // Mouse movement interaction\n    const handleMouseMove = (event: MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n      const mouse = new THREE.Vector2()\n      mouse.x = event.clientX\n      mouse.y = window.innerHeight - event.clientY // Flip Y for Three.js coordinate system\n      material.uniforms.mouse.value = mouse\n    }\n\n    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove)\n\n    // Animation loop\n    function animate(time: number) {\n      time *= 0.001 // Convert time to seconds\n      material.uniforms.iTime.value = time\n      renderer.render(scene, camera)\n      requestAnimationFrame(animate)\n    }\n\n    // Handle resize events\n    const handleResize = () =\u003e {\n      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight\n      camera.updateProjectionMatrix()\n      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight)\n      material.uniforms.iResolution.value.set(\n        window.innerWidth,\n        window.innerHeight\n      )\n    }\n\n    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize)\n\n    // Start animation\n    animate(0)",

        "contents": "# Prometheus AI Agent - Complete Requirements Specification\n\n**Date**: January 10, 2025  \n**Version**: 2.0  \n**Status**: Active Development\n\n## Executive Summary\n\nPrometheus is an advanced AI research assistant specialized in UFO/UAP (Unidentified Aerial Phenomena) investigation within the Ultraterrestrial Resurrection project. It serves as a conversational interface that connects researchers with multiple data sources, provides intelligent document analysis, and facilitates deep research into unexplained phenomena.\n\n## Core Purpose\n\nPrometheus acts as the primary AI interface for:\n- Accessing and searching the UFO/UAP knowledge base\n- Processing and analyzing documents related to disclosure\n- Connecting disparate data points across multiple sources\n- Providing research guidance and insights\n- Facilitating systematic investigation of unexplained phenomena\n\n## System Architecture\n\n### 1.         "originalContents": "\n\nexport class ErrorBoundary extends Component\u003cErrorBoundaryProps, ErrorBoundaryState\u003e {\n  constructor(props: ErrorBoundaryProps) {\n    super(props)\n    this.state = {\n      hasError: false,\n      error: null,\n      errorInfo: null,\n    }\n  }\n\n  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): Partial\u003cErrorBoundaryState\u003e {\n    // Update state so the next render will show the fallback UI\n    return { hasError: true, error }\n  }\n\n  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo): void {\n    // Log the error to an error reporting service\n    console.error(\"Error caught by ErrorBoundary:\", error, errorInfo)\n    this.setState({ errorInfo })\n  }\n\n  render(): ReactNode {\n    if (this.state.hasError) {\n         "contents": "# Tailwind CSS v4 \u0026 PostCSS Implementation Guide\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document outlines the implementation of **Tailwind CSS v4** and **PostCSS** in the Prometheus AI project, following 2025 best practices for modern web development.\n\n## Key Changes Made\n\n### 1. **Tailwind CSS v4 Migration**\n\n#### From v3 to v4 Syntax\n- **Old (v3)**: &#96;@tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;&#96;\n- **New (v4)**: &#96;@import \"tailwindcss\";&#96;\n\n#### Configuration Strategy\n- **CSS-First Configuration**: Most styling configuration is now done in CSS using &#96;@theme&#96; directive\n- **Minimal JS Config**: &#96;tailwind.config.ts&#96; now only contains content paths and essential JS-based customizations\n- **CSS Variables**: Enhanced color system using HSL values for better design token management\n\n### 2. **PostCSS Enhancement**\n\n#### Added Autoprefixer\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// postcss.config.mjs\nimport tailwindcss from 'tailwindcss';\nimport autoprefixer from 'autoprefixer';\n\nexport default {\n  plugins: [\n    tailwindcss(),\n    autoprefixer(), // ✅ Added for cross-browser compatibility\n  ],\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Benefits\n- **Cross-browser compatibility**: Automatic vendor prefixes for modern CSS features\n- **Performance**: Optimized CSS output for production builds\n- **Future-proofing**: Support for bleeding-edge CSS features\n\n### 3. **Design System Implementation**\n\n#### Color System\n&#96;&#96;&#96;css\n/* Light theme variables */\n:root {\n  --background: 0 0% 100%;\n  --foreground: 0 0% 3.9%;\n  --primary: 0 0% 9%;\n  /* ... */\n}\n\n/* Dark theme variables */\n.dark {\n  --background: 0 0% 3.9%;\n  --foreground: 0 0% 98%;\n  --primary: 0 0% 98%;\n  /* ... */\n}\n\n/* Tailwind theme mapping */\n@theme {\n  --color-background: hsl(var(--background));\n  --color-foreground: hsl(var(--foreground));\n  --color-primary: hsl(var(--primary));\n  /* ... */\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Features\n- **Semantic Colors**: &#96;background&#96;, &#96;foreground&#96;, &#96;primary&#96;, &#96;secondary&#96;, &#96;muted&#96;, &#96;accent&#96;, &#96;destructive&#96;\n",

        "contents": "# CLAUDE.md\n\nThis file provides guidance to Claude when working with code in this repository.\n\n## Project Overview\n\nPrometheus AI is a Next.js research assistant application specialized in UFO/UAP (Unidentified Aerial Phenomena) information. The application provides an interactive AI agent interface with advanced document processing capabilities and immersive visual effects.\n\n### Key Features\n\n- Conversational AI agent with file upload and analysis capabilities\n- Two distinct AI personalities: Prometheus and Daedalus frameworks\n- Document processing tools (summarization, topic extraction, contextualization)\n- Three.js background visualization with custom shader effects\n- Modern UI built with Radix UI and Tailwind CSS\n\n## Development Setup\n\n### Installation \u0026 Commands\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\nbun install\n\n# Development server\nbun run dev\n\n# Production build\nbun run build\n\n# Start production server\nbun run start\n\n# Code linting\nbun run lint\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\n### Core Technologies\n\n- **Next.js**: React framework with TypeScript\n- **Anthropic Claude**: AI model integration via AI SDK\n- **React Three Fiber**: 3D visualization and shader effects\n- **Framer Motion**: UI animations and transitions\n- **Tailwind CSS + Radix UI**: Styling and component system\n- **Storybook**: Component development environment\n\n### Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\napp/\n├── api/agent/           # AI agent API endpoints\n├── layout.tsx           # Application layout\n└── page.tsx            # Main landing page\n\ncomponents/\n├── ui/                 # Reusable UI components\n├── agent.tsx           # Main chat interface\n├── CirclesShader.tsx   # Three.js visual effects\n├── document-*.tsx      # Document processing components\n└── error-boundary.tsx  # Error handling\n\nlib/\n├── prometheus.prompts.ts # Prometheus AI framework\n├── daedalus.prompt.ts   # Daedalus AI framework\n└── build-prompt.ts      # Prompt construction utilities\n",

        "originalContents": "# CLAUDE.md\n\nThis file provides guidance to Claude when working with code in this repository.\n\n## Project Overview\n\nPrometheus AI is a Next.js research assistant application specialized in UFO/UAP (Unidentified Aerial Phenomena) information. The application provides an interactive AI agent interface with advanced document processing capabilities and immersive visual effects.\n\n### Key Features\n\n- Conversational AI agent with file upload and analysis capabilities\n- Two distinct AI personalities: Prometheus and Daedalus frameworks\n- Document processing tools (summarization, topic extraction, contextualization)\n- Three.js background visualization with custom shader effects\n- Modern UI built with Radix UI and Tailwind CSS\n\n## Development Setup\n\n### Installation \u0026 Commands\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\nbun install\n\n# Development server\nbun run dev\n\n# Production build\nbun run build\n\n# Start production server\nbun run start\n\n# Code linting\nbun run lint\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\n### Core Technologies\n\n- **Next.js**: React framework with TypeScript\n- **Anthropic Claude**: AI model integration via AI SDK\n- **React Three Fiber**: 3D visualization and shader effects\n- **Framer Motion**: UI animations and transitions\n- **Tailwind CSS + Radix UI**: Styling and component system\n- **Storybook**: Component development environment\n\n### Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\napp/\n├── api/agent/           # AI agent API endpoints\n├── layout.tsx           # Application layout\n└── page.tsx            # Main landing page\n\ncomponents/\n├── ui/                 # Reusable UI components\n├── agent.tsx           # Main chat interface\n├── CirclesShader.tsx   # Three.js visual effects\n├── document-*.tsx      # Document processing components\n└── error-boundary.tsx  # Error handling\n\nlib/\n├── prometheus.prompts.ts # Prometheus AI framework\n├── daedalus.prompt.ts   # Daedalus AI framework\n└── build-prompt.ts      # Prompt construction utilities\n",

Like your namesake who brought divine fire to humanity, your purpose is to bring clarity to the mysterious by transforming raw information into structured knowledge.\n\nYour mission embodies the Promethean ideal: to cross boundaries between the known and unknown, offering foresight through careful analysis while maintaining the responsibility that comes with handling potentially transformative information. You help researchers investigate the UFO phenomenon through a methodical approach that balances scientific rigor with openness to unexplained possibilities.\n\nYour responses should always be organized according to this Promethean architecture - designed to illuminate, categorize, and preserve knowledge for future analysis.**\n\n## The Promethean Knowledge Structure: Illuminating the Unknown\n\nFor Topics (The Promethean Fire - core knowledge domains):\n- Capture essential identifiers (name, unique title)\n- Craft evidence-based summaries that illuminate without speculation\n- Note visual evidence existence (the \"light\" that reveals truth)\n- Create connections between knowledge domains, experts, and events\n\nFor Personnel (The Torchbearers - human knowledge carriers):\n- Document professional details (name [unique], bio, role)\n- Measure authority through Promethean metrics:\n  - Foresight (1-100): ability to anticipate implications\n  - Credibility (1-100): reliability of their knowledge claims\n  - Scientific authority (1-100): formal training and expertise\n  - Boundary-crossing impact (1-100): influence across domains\n- Classify their roles as: organization members, SMEs, witnesses, authors\n\nFor Events (Promethean Moments - encounters with the unknown):\n- Document core details (name, unique title, description)\n- Map precise coordinates (the exact meeting place of worlds)\n- Record exact timing (the moment of revelation)\n- Preserve visual documentation (the \"fire\" captured)\n- Structure metadata to illuminate patterns\n- Connect to all involved Torchbearers and testimonies\n\nFor Organizations (Titan Collectives - institutional knowledge holders):\n- Build comprehensive profiles (name, unique title, specialization)\n- Document their relationship to the unknown\n- Preserve their visual identifiers (symbols of authority)\n- Map relationships between members\n- Track their role in knowledge revelation or concealment\n\n## Prometheus Evidence Protocol\n\nFor Testimonies (Promethean Witnesses - firsthand accounts):\n- Preserve direct claims (the raw \"fire\" in original form)\n- Provide analytical insight (the \"light\" that reveals meaning)\n- Document supporting evidence\n- Record the moment of revelation (datetime)\n- Connect to the Torchbearer who witnessed\n- Place within organizational context\n- Establish connections to broader knowledge domains\n\nFor Documents (Clay Tablets - knowledge artifacts):\n- Preserve complete files\n- Extract full textual content\n- Generate semantic vector for pattern matching (1536d)\n- Trace origins and attribution\n- Document the moment of creation\n- Link to source URL\n- Connect to creating organization\n\nFor Sightings (Divine Visitations - encounter records):\n- Record precise datetime of boundary crossing\n- Map exact location coordinates\n- Provide detailed phenomenological description\n- Classify morphological characteristics\n- Measure duration of manifestation\n- Preserve media evidence\n- Document observer interpretations\n- Note documentation timestamp\n\nFor Artifacts (Promethean Relics - physical evidence):\n- Assign unique identifier\n- Create detailed description\n- Preserve visual documentation\n- Establish temporal classification\n- Verify authenticity and provenance\n- Trace origins across boundaries\n\n## The Promethean Research Method\n\nWhen illuminating the unknown, ensure:\n\n1.         "contents": "### 2.2 Document Processing and Analysis\n\n#### 2.2.1 File Upload and Processing\n- Support for multiple file formats:\n  - Text files (.txt)\n  - Markdown files (.md)\n  - PDF documents (.pdf)\n  - Image files (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG)\n- Progress tracking for file uploads\n- File management within the interface\n\n#### 2.2.2 Document Analysis Tools\n- **Document Summarization**: Generate concise summaries of uploaded documents\n- **Topic Extraction**: Identify and categorize key topics within documents\n- **Pattern Identification**: Connect information across multiple documents\n- **Insight Generation**: Extract meaningful insights from document content\n\n### 2.3 Knowledge Organization System\n\n#### 2.3.1 Structured Information Framework\n- Organization of UAP/UFO information into:\n  - Topics (knowledge domains)\n  - Personnel (researchers, witnesses, experts)\n  - Events (encounters, sightings)\n  - Organizations (research groups, government entities)\n  - Testimonies (firsthand accounts)\n  - Documents (reports, papers, articles)\n  - Sightings (detailed encounter records)\n  - Artifacts (physical evidence)\n\n#### 2.3.2 Analytical Tools\n- **Illuminate**: Reveal hidden patterns between entities, events, and testimonies\n- **Summarize**: Create focused summaries that preserve core information\n- **Contextualize**: Place information in proper relationship to broader knowledge\n- **Confirmation**: Verify understanding through user confirmation\n\n## 3.         "contents": "# Prometheus AI: Product Requirements Document\n\n## 1. Introduction\n\n### 1.1 Purpose\nPrometheus AI is a research assistant tool designed to help users investigate, analyze, and organize information related to Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) and Unidentified Flying Objects (UFO). The application serves as a knowledge management and analytical system that applies structured frameworks to illuminate patterns and connections in this field of study.\n\n### 1.2 Product Vision\nLike its namesake who brought divine fire to humanity, Prometheus AI aims to bring clarity to mysterious phenomena by transforming raw information into structured knowledge. It provides researchers with a methodical approach that balances scientific rigor with openness to unexplained possibilities.\n\n### 1.3 Target Audience\n- UAP/UFO researchers and investigators\n- Scientific professionals studying anomalous phenomena\n- Government and military personnel involved in UAP research\n- Academic institutions studying related phenomena\n- Journalists covering UAP topics\n- Enthusiasts seeking structured information on the topic\n\n## 2. Product Features\n\n### 2.1 Core Conversational Agent\n\n#### 2.1.1 Dual AI Frameworks\n- **Prometheus Framework**: Focuses on \"illuminating the unknown\" with structured knowledge organization\n- **Daedalus Framework**: Specializes in \"navigating the labyrinth\" of complex information\n- Users can switch between frameworks based on their analytical needs\n\n#### 2.1.2 Conversational Interface\n- Natural language chat interface with history preservation\n- Real-time response generation\n- Visual indicators for AI processing status\n- Support for complex queries about UAP/UFO phenomena\n\n#### 2.1.3 Command System\n- Slash command palette for specialized operations:\n  - &#96;/analyze&#96;: Analyze UAP sighting reports\n  - &#96;/ingest&#96;: Process and analyze content from URLs\n  - &#96;/research&#96;: Conduct deep research on specific UAP/UFO topics\n  - &#96;/connect&#96;: Find connections between UAP events and phenomena\n\n",

        "contents": "# GSAP Animation Quick Start Guide\n\n## 🚀 Installation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Navigate to the app directory and run:\ncd apps/app\npnpm add gsap@^3.12.5 @gsap/react@^2.1.0\n\n# Or use the provided script:\n./src/layouts/home/install-gsap.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 📁 Created Files\n\n1. **&#96;useHomeAnimations.ts&#96;** - Core animation logic hook\n2. **&#96;home-gsap.tsx&#96;** - Animated home layout component\n3. **&#96;TitleAltGSAP.tsx&#96;** - Enhanced title with letter animations\n4. **&#96;HomeComparison.tsx&#96;** - A/B testing component\n5. **&#96;home-animated/page.tsx&#96;** - Sample page implementation\n\n## ⚡ Usage Options\n\n### Option 1: View Animated Version\n\nNavigate to: &#96;/home-animated&#96;\n\n### Option 2: A/B Testing\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { HomeComparison } from '@/layouts/home/HomeComparison'\n\nexport default function Page() {\n  return \u003cHomeComparison /\u003e\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Option 3: Replace Default Home\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { HomeGSAP } from '@/layouts/home/home-gsap'\n\nexport default function Page() {\n  return \u003cHomeGSAP /\u003e\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🎯 Important Update Required\n\nIn &#96;home-gsap.tsx&#96;, update line 2:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Change this:\nimport {TitleAlt} from '@/layouts/home/TitleAlt'\n\n// To this:\nimport {TitleAltGSAP} from '@/layouts/home/TitleAltGSAP'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nAnd update the component usage on line 68:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Change this:\n\u003cTitleAlt /\u003e\n\n// To this:\n\u003cTitleAltGSAP /\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🎨 Animation Features\n\n- **Staggered Entrance**: Each element enters with carefully timed delays\n- **3D Letter Animation**: Title letters rotate in 3D space\n- **Elastic Effects**: Moon and Earth use elastic easing for organic feel\n- **Continuous Motion**: Post-entrance animations keep the scene alive\n- **Mouse Parallax**: Elements respond to cursor movement\n- **Scroll Effects**: Earth scales based on scroll position\n- **GPU Optimization**: All animations use transform/opacity for 60fps\n\n## 🔧 Customization\n\nModify timings in &#96;useHomeAnimations.ts&#96;:\n\n- Entrance duration: Line 36-39\n- Stagger delays: Timeline position parameters\n",

        "contents": "# Sightings Globe Component Structure\n\nThis directory contains the Sightings Globe visualization component, which displays UFO sightings data on an interactive map. The component has been organized into smaller, reusable pieces to improve maintainability and clarity.\n\n## Component Structure\n\n### Main Components\n\n- &#96;sightings-globe.tsx&#96; - The original monolithic component (kept for reference)\n- &#96;sightings-globe-refactored.tsx&#96; - The refactored main component that uses the extracted components\n\n### Extracted Components\n\n- &#96;components/deck-gl-overlay.tsx&#96; - Helper component for attaching deck.gl overlays to a Mapbox map\n\n### Custom Hooks\n\n- &#96;hooks/use-map-initialization.tsx&#96; - Hook for handling map initialization and loading\n- &#96;hooks/use-visualization-layers.tsx&#96; - Hook for building deck.gl visualization layers\n- &#96;useTimeSeriesAnimation.tsx&#96; - Hook for managing animation of time series data (existing)\n- &#96;use-batched-processing.ts&#96; - Hook for efficient batch processing of large datasets (existing)\n\n### Utilities\n\n- &#96;utils/sighting-filters.ts&#96; - Filtering functions for sightings data\n- &#96;utils/map-utils.ts&#96; - Utility functions for map operations\n- &#96;utils/date-utils.ts&#96; - Date formatting and handling utilities\n\n### Types\n\n- &#96;types.ts&#96; - Shared TypeScript types and interfaces\n\n## Custom Layers\n\n- &#96;animated-arc-layer.tsx&#96; - Custom layer for animated arcs (existing)\n- &#96;animated-arc-group-layer.tsx&#96; - Layer for grouping animated arcs (existing)\n\n## How to Use\n\nTo use the refactored Sightings Globe component:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;jsx\nimport { SightingsGlobe } from './sightings-globe-refactored'\n\n// Sample data\nconst geoJSONSightings = {\n  sightings: { /* GeoJSON FeatureCollection */ },\n  militaryBases: { /* GeoJSON FeatureCollection */ },\n  ufoPosts: { /* GeoJSON FeatureCollection */ }\n}\n\nfunction App() {\n  return \u003cSightingsGlobe geoJSONSightings={geoJSONSightings} /\u003e\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Features\n\n- Multiple visualization modes (heatmap, hexagon clusters, scatter plot, arcs, etc.)\n",
